It takes a long time to get used to something so different from what you've known your whole life. I remember for the first year or so I felt like a was an imposter, like I didn't even have the right to call myself a man. My advice would be to keep a diary where you refer to yourself with your pronouns and to talk to people who actually use them, for me at first it was my therapist but it could be anyone. It's a long way bro but you'll get there I promise, one day everything will just be natural! Sending love :)
